edit.description: agreement test: real renderSchemaForPrompt output driven through real parsePending

summary: renderSchemaForPrompt and parsePending are an ungated agreement seam in PendingSchema.ts — nothing drives the real writer through the real reader.

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

tests.asserts: entries built from renderSchemaForPrompt's stated hints (tag charset/length, notes/summary caps) parse via parsePending; entries violating a stated hint constraint fail parsePending

acceptance: New agreement test passes; it would have caught the tag-charset and notes-cap drift instances this entry supersedes (both already in sync today, now pinned against silent regression).
notes: Closes the class, not just the two known-fixed instances (v0.8 §3 tag-grammar reduction; notes cap already rendered). Supersedes inbox's TAG-PATTERN-SLICE-CONSTRAINT / PENDING-NOTES-CAP-VISIBILITY concern. Also this tick's posture-sweep finding for the PendingSchema.ts neighborhood (bootstrap rotation).

edit.description: pin parsePendingLoose's 'never on a write path' contract mechanically

summary: parsePendingLoose's 'never used on a write path' contract (PendingSchema.ts:324-329) is prose-only — no test pins it.

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

tests.asserts: parsePendingLoose has exactly one production call site (job.ts's read-only job-listing) and it never rewrites pending.json

acceptance: New test fails if a future call site appears outside the documented read-only listing, forcing deliberate review before it ships.
notes: Posture-sweep finding, PendingSchema.ts neighborhood (bootstrap rotation, no prior stamp). A pinning test is the proportionate fix — one call site today, correctly used; a type-brand is more machinery than the current risk justifies (collaboration.md complexity signal).

edit.description: add optional hint?: string to PendingGateOptions, appended to both violation messages
cover hint present/absent on both violation paths

summary: pendingGate has no injection point for chain-authored operator guidance on a violation — a bay's hand-rolled fork carried this, the builtin drops it.

tests.asserts: hint text appended verbatim to both schema-violation and fence-violation failure output when supplied; output unchanged from today when omitted

acceptance: pendingGate({ ..., hint: 'park it, never re-scope' }) echoes the hint in both failure branches; default behavior unchanged.
notes: Passes the second-implementation test — chain supplies text, engine supplies enforcement. Keep minimal: one string, no per-violation-class customization; richer needs stay a chain-side run() wrap, per the inbox finding's own stated alternative.
